mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.* FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN role_auth ra ON r.id = ra.role_id JOIN auth a ON ra.auth_id = a.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND type IN ('M', 'C');

SELECT DISTINCT a.code FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN role_auth ra ON r.id = ra.role_id JOIN auth a ON ra.auth_id = a.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND a.type IN ('C', 'F');
